title: Police Blotter: 17 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Seventeen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Nov. 18–19, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges or federal holds — DWI, theft, marijuana possession and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Seventeen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Wednesday and Thursday, November 18–19, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges or federal holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Jaime Rosales

Rosales was arrested on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 10:47 p.m. on a charge of driving while intoxicated, second offense, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Jose Luis Benavides Jr.

Benavides was arrested by the Laredo Police Department on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 11:19 p.m. on a charge of theft of mail involving 10 or fewer addresses, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $5,000.
